about_short_description.short_description: Emirates Islamic is a financial services institution that provides banking services and wealth management solutions.

product.name: Personal Banking Accounts and Deposits
product.description: Sharia-compliant current, savings, and investment deposit accounts for individuals, including specialized savings and fixed-term deposit options.

product.name: Personal Finance
product.description: Sharia-compliant personal financing for individual customers, with repayment terms and profit rates determined by the customer profile, tenure, and bank policy.

product.name: Credit Cards
product.description: A range of Sharia-compliant credit cards for purchases, travel, cash access, balance transfers, installment payments, and card-linked rewards and offers.

product.name: Home Finance
product.description: Sharia-compliant residential property financing for customers purchasing or financing homes, with repayment periods and pricing subject to eligibility and bank policy.

product.name: Auto Finance
product.description: Sharia-compliant vehicle financing for individuals purchasing cars, with monthly repayment arrangements and pricing subject to eligibility and bank policy.

product.name: Priority Banking
product.description: A relationship-led banking service for eligible customers combining dedicated support with banking, financing, card, foreign-exchange, and wealth-management solutions.
